text.tspan: Mains side: 14 AWG, grounded metal enclosure, breaker sized for the 12.6 A total.
Keep it physically apart from the 3.3 V wiring.
Staged thermostat: 1, 2, or 3 relays on depending on how far below
the setpoint the room is. 2 °F deadband, 15 s minimum on/off per
bank, wear leveling by cycle count and runtime. The encoder button
uses the internal pull-up. Firmware in PlatformIO and ESPHome forms.
